description: This file contains unit tests for AdoNetQueueAdapterReceiver implementations against different relational databases (SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL). It includes test setup/teardown, message enqueue/dequeue validation, and shutdown behavior, specifically targeting AdoNet stream message handling within Orleans streaming infrastructure.

classes.description: Test class for AdoNetQueueAdapterReceiver against SQL Server.

classes.description: Test class for AdoNetQueueAdapterReceiver against MySQL.

classes.name: PostgreSqlAdoNetQueueAdapterReceiverTests
classes.description: Test class for AdoNetQueueAdapterReceiver against PostgreSQL.

classes.name: AdoNetQueueAdapterReceiverTests
classes.description: Abstract base class containing shared test logic for different relational database implementations of AdoNetQueueAdapterReceiver.
